## 1. Sri Lanka’s welfare registry dropped 331,653 names and added 153,511 after a nationwide re‑certification.

The updated rolls now list <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">991,800 people eligible</span> for cash transfers across the two lowest‑income bands, with <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">payments scheduled to start on 27 November</span>. Lists were displayed at local offices with a 10‑day window for objections before divisional committees review cases.

The exercise followed criticism of leakage when <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">over 3.12 million self‑declarations</span> were filed last year, and it comes as <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">transitional categories ended in 2025–26</span> to contain costs. Officials said a second tranche of revisions would follow, aiming to focus benefits more tightly while preserving fiscal room in a programme central to social stability.

## 2. The central bank warned inflation could rise if oil stays around $100 a barrel for longer.

Consumer prices rose <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">8.1 percent year‑on‑year in September</span>, the <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">highest in 40 months</span>, after domestic fuel was priced to reflect global markets. Authorities said they would avoid using interest rates to chase supply‑side shocks unless demand pressures built.

The state fuel supplier has <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">lifted pump prices by roughly half</span> since the Middle East conflict began, increasing pass‑through to transport and power. Policymakers said earlier forecasts assumed crude drifting to about <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">$90 by year‑end</span>, a path that now looks less certain.

## 3. The cabinet approved a $100 million Asian Development Bank loan for a macro‑recovery programme.

Half the financing is policy‑based and half is for investments through the lender’s ordinary capital resources (the ADB’s main, non‑concessional window). The package forms part of a wider <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">$620 million envelope</span> negotiated to support reforms aligned with the IMF’s Extended Fund Facility (an upper‑credit‑tranche programme that anchors fiscal and structural conditions).

Officials said loan talks had concluded and signing would follow internal processes. A related infrastructure push under the Mahaweli water scheme secured a <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">$60 million OPEC Fund facility</span>, and authorities tied both packages to resilience and inclusion goals.

## 4. Police suspended senior officers and the bar demanded an impartial probe after a custodial death in Homagama.

Three officers were removed from duty first, followed by the <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">arrest of the crimes division head</span> and <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">suspension of the station chief</span>. The courts ordered a <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">post‑mortem and preliminary inquiries</span>, while an independent professional body cited <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">constitutional guarantees on life</span> and due process.

The case drew scrutiny as medical findings pointed to multiple injuries, and prosecutors were urged to preserve evidence. The human‑rights community said accountability would test longstanding pledges to end abuse in detention.

## 5. Sri Lanka set performance‑based frameworks for state‑enterprise collective agreements from 2027.

An expert committee aligned workplace pacts with industrial, trade union and shop‑and‑office laws, adding <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">profit‑sharing and bonus guidelines</span>. Existing deals remain <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">in force through 2026</span> to allow transition.

## 6. Customs said October revenue hit 152.8 billion rupees by the 21st day, surpassing 79 percent of the month’s target.

Collections exceeded the annual goal by 103.6 percent with stronger enforcement and a rebound in imports after prior controls. Last year’s take rose 64.2 percent to <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">2.55 trillion rupees</span>, lifting the department to a top‑tier role in meeting <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">IMF‑linked fiscal targets</span>.

## 7. Rights groups said the organised‑crime bill risked replicating abusive anti‑terror provisions.

Critics flagged <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">detention orders of up to a year</span> with limited judicial oversight and admissibility of <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">police‑taken confessions</span>, echoing past practices under the <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">PTA</span> (Prevention of Terrorism Act, a 1979 law widely criticised for arbitrary detention and torture). They also warned of <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">broad surveillance powers</span> without court orders to obtain telecom and location data.

## 8. Japan pledged over 600 million rupees to build a Kelani River water‑quality data platform through 2030.

The programme equips regulators and universities to monitor a basin that supplies drinking water to Colombo and hosts <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">over 5,400 industries</span>. Partners cited <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">missing groundwater standards</span> and climate risks as barriers to cleaner supply.

## 9. The navy and coast guard seized 561.7 kg of heroin and crystal meth on a Matara beach in a joint operation.

The haul, packed in sacks and travel bags beside a dinghy, carried an estimated street value <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">above 11.8 billion rupees</span>. Investigators said combined maritime operations in the past year had netted narcotics worth <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">about 97 billion rupees</span>.

## 10. Online appointments became mandatory for passport applicants at five regional offices from 29 October.

The booking system covers one‑day and normal services at centres in <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">Matara, Kandy, Kurunegala, Vavuniya and Jaffna</span>, with <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">family slots capped at two adults and three children</span>. Urgent cases may still use the <span style="background-color:#EBEBEB;border-radius:3px;padding:0 2px">head office without prior booking</span>.
